title.zh: Crypto billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne each donate £36 million to Farage’s Reform UK
title.en: Crypto billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne each donate £36 million to Farage’s Reform UK

current_state.zh: Crypto billionaires Ben Delo and Christopher Harborne each donated £36 million to Nigel Farage's Reform UK, as the House of Lords weighs a bill that would ban crypto political donations and cap overseas giving at £100,000 annually.
